name: Radio
description: Plays internet radio or an audio link in a voice channel. Opens from the plugins at the bottom left.
details:
Plays internet radio in your voice channel. Paste a station's stream address (mp3 or aac stream) or a link to an audio file, and the bot joins the channel and plays it.

Window: while in a voice channel, click the radio icon at the bottom left. You can pause, stop, change the volume and go back to recently played streams with one click. Recent streams are saved per server.

When nobody is left in the channel, the bot leaves on its own after a minute.
author: Bunker
